kurz: Fotzelschnitten are stale bread soaked in egg and milk and fried golden brown. It works precisely because the bread is old.
bild_im_kopf: Like a dry sponge: only something thirsty soaks itself properly full.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Slice stale bread or braided loaf
schluesselmomente.warum: Old bread is firmer because the starch has reorganised. It soaks up the egg mixture without falling apart.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Soak in egg and milk with a little sugar
schluesselmomente.warum: The liquid reaches the centre. The egg sets as it fries and holds everything together.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Fry in butter over medium heat until golden brown
schluesselmomente.warum: Sugar, egg and milk brown quickly. Medium heat gives the inside time to set.
Cinnamon and sugar stick to the warm butter.
